name: Aozaki Touko
source:
Aozaki Touko appeared as the sister of Aozaki Aoko in the novel Mahoutsukai no Yoru and made a later appearance in Kara no Kyoukai.

In Kara no Kyoukai, she is shown as a puppet maker and an occasional buildings designer. Together with Kokutou Mikiya, she runs a kind of detective agency (Garan no Dou (伽藍の洞)) that only engages in cases with supernatural or abnormal elements. Touko does not share a particularly good relationship with her sister, yet this break's causes are unknown.

She's a powerful magus, and she can reproduce parts of a body that can be used instead of the lost part. While this would be nothing special, she can copy the piece in such a perfect way that it comes close to the real one. The glasses Toono Shiki wears were initially made by Touko. Her sister Aoko stole them from Touko and made them indestructible.

As a doll-maker, she received a Sealing Designation for creating a doll (body) that was a replica of her own body.

Touko has 20 Magic Circuits, which surprised the Aozaki clan as the number of Magic Circuits in their line had been dwindling. Due to her formidable power, Mage's Association dubbed her with the color Tou (橙, Orange), close to the three primary colors. She wished to get the color Blue, but that title was taken by her sister Aoko.
